frost_shard.name: Frost Shard
frost_shard.lore: Cold enough to ache. The Frost Offering in the Aurora Court wants it.

winter_key.name: Winter Key
winter_key.lore: Opens the rime-sealed door to the Crown of Winter.

onDone.text: The ice wall groans and cracks open. The gallery lies beyond.

mechanics.doneText: The shrine balances. Warmth and cold settle.

waves.say: Frost spreads over the circle. Figures rise from the snow.

onDone.text: The frost lets go. A shard of ice rests on the plate.
Steam hisses. The ice wall to the crevasse sags and melts away.

onStep.text: A valve wheel groans round. One more.

mechanics.jam: The valve is frozen solid. The first valve opens the way.

onDone.text: The aurora flares and a sealed niche opens in the north wall.

mechanics.failText: The colours scatter. Follow the ceiling: cyan, magenta, lime, light blue... or so it seems.

onOpen.text: The offering block shudders and the rime wall behind it falls away.

mechanics.hint: A block of blue ice with a hollow the size of a shard.
mechanics.verb: lays the shard in the ice and the wall behind falls away.

onOpen.text: The rime door to the Crown of Winter shatters.

mechanics.hint: A door of black ice with a keyhole frozen over.
mechanics.verb: sets the Winter Key and the door of black ice shatters.

encounters.say: Ice cracks overhead. The gallery is not empty.
The aurora paints the ceiling in four colours. Pedestals wait in the south.

bosses.name: The Winter Warden
bosses.intro: The Winter Warden steps out of the frost. Shatter the three ice crowns on the pillars to break its ward.
bosses.deathText: The Winter Warden crumbles into snow.

shield.breakText: The crowns shatter! Strike the Warden now!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Winter Warden calls its servants.

effects.text: A blizzard rolls through the crown.
The Warden calls the deep winter.

completion.intro: The Glacier Crown. Balance the shrine, melt the valves, and cross the crevasse.
completion.message: The winter breaks. The crown closes shortly.
